masked_input.decision: Refund the $60 Extended overdraft fee, above the staff approval limit.
masked_input.facts: The policy allows this $60 refund, but it is above your $50 limit.

options.description: Members in good standing can receive up to 3 fee refunds in any 12-month period. The 12 months end on the date of the fee being reviewed, and refunds of any fee type count.

We refund a Courtesy Pay fee when a deposit that posted the same day would have covered the payment if it had posted first. Refunds and transfers between the member's own accounts don't count as deposits.
Staff can approve a fee refund of up to $50. Larger refunds need a supervisor.
A member is in good standing when there is no unpaid balance on any account. The Account Standing policy explains what counts as unpaid.
Each fee can be refunded only once. A fee that was already refunded, in this tool or in the core system, is not refunded again.

questions.prompt: Which of these policy clauses is the rule behind the `decision`, given the `facts`?
